teaser: A paper placemat covers the table, already doodled with three different cartoons before the food arrives. You are a 3, the number of expression, and an INTP, the type built for taking an idea apart quietly before anyone else notices there was a puzzle there at all. The pairing is not the easy charm people assume from a 3, nor the cool detachment people assume from an INTP. It is a mind that wants to turn a thought over in private, crossed with a path that keeps dragging that thought into the room to be shared out loud, half-finished, before it feels ready.
